name: La Clusaz
description: La Clusaz is a beautiful traditional Haute-Savoie village with real alpine character — wooden chalets, a central church, narrow streets, and some of the best mountain restaurants in the north Alps. One of the prettiest purpose-grown resorts. The ski area is 130km across 4 mountain sectors (Les Confins, Crêt du Merle, Etale, Combe des Juments). Known for: traditional food, lively apres, authentic village atmosphere.

overview.atmosphere: Authentic Haute-Savoie village, traditional charm, excellent food scene, good intermediate terrain.

beyond_skiing.ice_skating: 1,000 m² covered outdoor rink in village heart. Skate rental from size 24. DJ nights (Thursday 8-10pm), broom ball, family sessions. €6.50 adult / €5 child.
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Cinema, swimming, snowshoeing, paragliding from Etale. Famous for excellent food scene.

villages.name: La Clusaz centre
villages.character: Beautiful traditional village with central square, church, and excellent restaurants and shops

honest_drawbacks: Lower altitude — snow variable at season edges
